race.grandline.shark.desc: Children of the sea: tough hides, fast swimmers, resistant to the ocean's pull.
race.grandline.shark.passive.1: -5% damage taken, faster swimming, 15% less sea weakness
race.grandline.shark.passive.2: -8% damage taken, water breathing and sight, 30% less sea weakness
race.grandline.shark.passive.3: -10% damage taken, water breathing and sight, 45% less sea weakness
race.grandline.shark.passive.4: -12% damage taken, water breathing and sight, 60% less sea weakness

race.grandline.shark.v4.desc: Awaken: -50% damage taken, tidal waves every 3 s, half sea weakness.

race.grandline.angel.desc: Sky-born healers who leap high and glide down on bright wings.
race.grandline.angel.passive.2: Higher jumps, glide when falling, +50% regeneration, -10% move energy
race.grandline.angel.passive.3: Higher jumps, glide, +60% regeneration, -12% move energy
race.grandline.angel.passive.4: Higher jumps, glide, +75% regeneration, -15% move energy
race.grandline.angel.v3.desc: 10 s: heal 3% of max health every second, wings spread. Cooldown 80 s.
race.grandline.angel.v4.desc: Awaken: heal 4% per second, -15% damage taken, great wings.
race.grandline.req.v3.angel: Heal: one point per heart restored (%s / %s)
race.grandline.req.trial.angel: Clear the Trial of the Sky (Trial Keeper)
race.grandline.trial.start.angel: Trial of the Sky: Climb the floating platforms to the summit!
race.grandline.rabbit.desc: The fastest race: quick feet, long jumps, and bursts of blinding speed.
race.grandline.rabbit.v3.desc: 8 s: +60% speed and even higher jumps. Cooldown 50 s.
race.grandline.req.trial.rabbit: Clear the Trial of Speed (Trial Keeper)
race.grandline.trial.start.rabbit: Trial of Speed: Touch the eight glowing markers in order!
race.grandline.cyborg.desc: Part machine: armoured plating, efficient energy and electric discharges.
race.grandline.cyborg.v3.desc: Electric pulse that hits nearby enemies, restores 25% energy, -20% damage taken for 6 s. Cooldown 60 s.
race.grandline.cyborg.v4.desc: Awaken: -30% move energy, -20% damage taken, a discharge every 2 s.
race.grandline.req.trial.cyborg: Clear the Trial of Technology (Trial Keeper)
race.grandline.trial.start.cyborg: Trial of Technology: Destroy the four sentry cores!
race.grandline.ghoul.desc: Hunters of the night who feed on every hit they land.
race.grandline.ghoul.passive.1: 3% lifesteal and +8% damage at night, -3% cooldowns
race.grandline.ghoul.passive.2: 5% lifesteal, +12% damage at night, night vision, -5% cooldowns
race.grandline.ghoul.passive.3: 6% lifesteal, +15% damage at night, night vision, -7% cooldowns
race.grandline.ghoul.passive.4: 8% lifesteal, +18% damage at night, night vision, -10% cooldowns
race.grandline.ghoul.v3.desc: 10 s: +12% lifesteal, faster moves and cooldowns, enemies nearby revealed. Cooldown 70 s.
race.grandline.ghoul.v4.desc: Awaken: +15% lifesteal, faster moves, tendrils, enemies revealed.

message.grandline.flash_step.blocked: There is nowhere to step there.
message.grandline.dash_tutorial.start: Movement tutorial: Dash in every direction. Hold W, S, A or D and press Left Shift, then once more while jumping.
message.grandline.dash_tutorial.steps: Forward, back, left, right, and once in the air. Each Dash costs a little energy.
message.grandline.dash_tutorial.done: Well done! You can Dash any way you like now: forward, back, sideways and through the air.
npc.grandline.movement.greeting: Out at sea, the quick live longest. Let me show you how to move.
npc.grandline.movement.what.1: Dash is a short burst of speed every sailor learns from the start. It is yours already, no cost.
npc.grandline.movement.what.2: Press Left Shift and you cross about %s blocks in a blink. It does no damage: it gets you out of the way, or into range.
npc.grandline.movement.controls.1: Dash follows the keys you hold: W forward, S back, A left, D right, and the diagonals in between.
npc.grandline.movement.controls.2: Hold nothing and you dash straight ahead. Diagonals go no further than a straight dash.
npc.grandline.movement.controls.3: Your camera stays where it is, so you can dash sideways while keeping your eyes on a foe.
npc.grandline.movement.energy.1: Each Dash spends %s%% of your energy. Watch the energy bar: with too little left, nothing happens.
npc.grandline.movement.energy.2: After a Dash, catch your breath for %s seconds before the next.
npc.grandline.movement.air: It works in the air too: a Dash mid-jump carries you across gaps and holds your fall for a moment.
npc.grandline.result.tutorial_started: Show me what you can do!
npc.grandline.flash.greeting: True speed is not measured by how quickly you run, but by how effortlessly you cross the distance between two points.
npc.grandline.flash.what.1: Flash Step takes you instantly to where you are looking, up to %s blocks away: across a gap, up onto a ledge, down to the deck below.
npc.grandline.flash.what.2: It cannot pass through walls, and if there is no room to stand, it simply does not happen. Nothing is spent then.
npc.grandline.flash.how.1: Look where you want to be and press R. It works in mid-air and with any weapon, fruit or style.
npc.grandline.flash.how.2: Then rest for %s seconds. Each step costs %s%% of your energy.
npc.grandline.aura.greeting: Strength alone will only carry you so far. Learn to channel your inner energy, and your body will become your greatest weapon.
npc.grandline.aura.what.1: Aura coats your body and blade in hardened energy. Your punches, swords and shots strike harder, and blows against you land softer.
npc.grandline.aura.what.2: It even strikes elemental bodies that ordinary blows pass straight through. Switching it on costs no energy.
npc.grandline.aura.how: How do I strengthen my Aura?
npc.grandline.aura.how.1: Fight with it. Every real blow you land with Aura on, with fists, swords or guns, trains it.
npc.grandline.aura.how.2: As it grows, the coating spreads: from your hands to your arms, your chest, your head, and at last your whole body.
npc.grandline.aura.progress.none: You have not learned Aura yet.
npc.grandline.aura.progress.xp: %s / %s Aura XP to the next stage
npc.grandline.aura.progress.max: %s Aura XP: your Aura is complete
npc.grandline.aura.progress.bonus: +%s%% physical damage, %s%% less damage taken while active
npc.grandline.instinct.greeting: Close your eyes. Listen beyond the wind. Every living presence leaves an impression upon the world. Learn to perceive it, and danger will reveal itself before it reaches you.
npc.grandline.instinct.what.1: With Instinct on, your body moves before the blow lands: attacks are evaded on their own, one charge each.
npc.grandline.instinct.what.2: You also sense every threat within %s blocks, even through walls: who they are, how strong, and how hurt.
npc.grandline.instinct.how: How do I improve my awareness?
npc.grandline.instinct.how.1: Every attack you evade sharpens your senses and, in time, gives you more charges to evade with.
npc.grandline.instinct.how.2: Spent charges return one every %s seconds, whether Instinct is on or not. Some blows are too sudden to read: they break through.
npc.grandline.instinct.progress.none: You have not learned Instinct yet.
npc.grandline.instinct.progress.xp: %s / %s Instinct XP to the next charge
npc.grandline.result.technique_level: Come back when you are stronger.
